notes: Unit composition is the count share of military production orders (training plus field construction), not completed production. Cancelled or unpaid orders remain included; automatic/free units are not counted.
Technologies and landmarks mean ordered at least once, not completed. Research and construction may be cancelled.
A choice wins when its player wins the match. These associations do not measure causal strength or individual combat wins.
Sampled recent histories from six ladder-rank bands, optionally expanded through current-patch participants. This is not a complete ladder census or a random sample. Shared matches are deduplicated.
Civilisation results include all patch-identified sampled matches. Choice rankings use only successfully parsed and mapped player-games; replay availability can bias them.
Unknown blueprint IDs exclude that player-game from the affected choice category. Missing data is never a loss or zero usage.
Blueprint identities and classifications come from the installed 17.0.12260 catalog. No AoE4 World data or summaries are requested.
Each player-game is one observation. Teammates and repeated players are correlated; displayed intervals are descriptive and not cluster-adjusted.
Late-game technology and landmark choices depend on surviving long enough. Win rates are descriptive, not controlled estimates of their benefit.

technologies.name: Upgrade to Elite Knights or Lancers

provenance.patch: Official match replay URL build; downloaded headers cross-checked

metadata.purpose: Installed blueprint identity and classification only; no match outcomes.
notes: All blueprint IDs, classes, names and civilization references come from the installed-game catalog. No AoE4 World or other web dataset is used.
Military families group identical installed names after removing leading age-tier prefixes. Ghillie remains distinct from Scout; Jeanne's Elite Champion and Rider join their non-Elite families.
Military includes scouts and monks where installed classes mark them military. Workers, traders, livestock and fishing boats are excluded.
Unit entitySource IDs identify field-construction orders in the build namespace. Field and workshop units with the same family name are combined. Ambiguous entity identities remain unknown.
Landmarks include building_landmark blueprints and House of Wisdom wing research. Capital TCs, House of Wisdom construction, ordinary buildings and victory wonders are excluded.
Technology commands include both entity research and player upgrades such as Ottoman Vizier choices; the collector decodes the two command codes.
Civ availability comes from explicit catalog ownership and installed building menu references. The collector adds observed access, including mercenaries.
Unknown blueprint IDs must remain unknown; they cannot be counted as absent choices.
